description: This file defines a report parser class for budget reports in an Odoo module, including methods to calculate totals and retrieve account line data.

classes.name: budget_report
classes.description: A report parser class for generating budget reports, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with methods and data.

methods.name: post_total
methods.description: Calculates total previous amount, period proportion, and achievements for a given post object and date range.

methods.name: budget_total
methods.description: Aggregates totals from post_total over the given date range.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves account move line achievements for each account in the post object within the date range.
